name: Educating Our Children
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital responsibility of parents to educate their children in the fear and knowledge of the Lord, teaching them diligently in daily life as instructed in Deuteronomy 11:19. This education is grounded in loving God wholeheartedly (Deuteronomy 6:5) and includes both instruction and discipline, as Proverbs highlights the necessity of timely correction and reproof to guide children toward wisdom (Proverbs 13:24; 29:15). By training children in the right way from an early age, parents lay a foundation that will endure throughout their lives (Proverbs 22:6), ensuring they remain steadfast in the truth taught by their fathers and mothers (Proverbs 1:8).
